title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 17, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 20:17 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C2.8 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 04:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 471 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Sunny's keeping an eye on things. 👀🤍🖤

Two sunspot groups and a broad coronal-hole structure stand out in today’s solar images, while the coronagraph shows no clearly distinctive outward eruption.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
